decision: An application must be registered through requestNew-Platform-Members before any landing zone is provisioned for it.
why: Without the profile there is no Entra ID group, invoice section, or repo for a landing zone to attach to.
steps: Collect from the user: application name, owner email, and engineer email.
Confirm the values with the user, then trigger the workflow, which raises a pull request creating platform-members/{AppName}.json.
A platform engineer reviews and approves the pull request, and that approval provisions the application repo, Entra group, billing scope, and repository variables.
violations: Platform member file created by hand instead of through the workflow.
